description: A trip through several countries (max 5): one eSIM per country, each quoted with the same data pool and days unless given per country (gb omitted = sized for normal use from the days). Returns one line per country with price and buy_url, plus the total. Use when the customer names more than one country and a size; use recommend_config when they describe usage instead.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

destinations.description: Countries of the trip, any language or ISO codes, in travel order.

gb.description: Data pool per country in whole GB (1–100). Omit = sized for normal use from the days (1.5 GB/day).

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

per_country.description: Optional overrides per country (gb and/or days).

name: plan_trip
title: Plan a multi-country trip
